Manage Access

Look up an account and set the license that decides whether it can run Archie, the same controls as the app’s own admin console.

Checking your access…

This page is for Otian admins. Back to your account

Account

Start typing a name or an email; matches appear as you go. You do not need the whole address.

-
-
Set access

The license is the one thing that decides whether this account can run Archie. Everything else here is a record, not a permission.

They keep access through the end of this day. Leave it empty for a grant with no end date, which is what every comped account has today.

Labels

Who somebody is to us. These decide nothing: a label has never granted access and must never be read for it.

AI allowance

What the AI-included plan sells: usage on our own AI account, spent through Archie. The license above decides whether Archie runs at all; this decides whether they have anything to think with when it does.

Giving days spends the same allowance a paid month buys, on our account. Nothing renews it: a comped stretch ends when its days run out, where a paying customer’s next invoice refills theirs. Press it twice for twice as long.

Replay parked grants
Applies everything parked for accounts that have since signed in: licenses and add-on grants alike. Granting to an address before its first sign-in is what parks one.

Licenses: staff · bought · on a plan · on a business plan · granted · none. The legacy tier array is written from the license, so an Archie older than that field still reads the right answer. Changes take effect the next time the app checks access. Also see Invoice a client · Ops console.
